questions.question: The Treaty of Purandar (1665) was signed between the Mughal forces under Aurangzeb and which Maratha ruler?
questions.explanation: The Treaty of Purandar was signed between Jai Singh I (on behalf of Aurangzeb) and Shivaji in 1665, whereby Shivaji ceded 23 of his forts to the Mughals.

questions.question: Chilika Lake, a brackish water lagoon and a major wintering ground for migratory birds, is located in which Indian state?
questions.explanation: Chilika Lake is in Odisha. It is the largest coastal lagoon in India and a Ramsar site.

questions.question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) appointed?
questions.explanation: Article 148 provides for the appointment of the CAG. Article 149 defines duties, 150 prescribes accounts format, 151 deals with audit reports.

questions.question: Which institution is the apex financing agency for the Short Term Cooperative Credit Structure in India?
questions.explanation: NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) is the apex institution for cooperative credit. NHB handles housing, SIDBI handles small industries.

questions.question: The Nagarjuna Sagar Dam, one of the earliest and largest masonry dams in the world, is built across which river in Telangana?
questions.explanation: Nagarjuna Sagar Dam is built across the Krishna River in Telangana. It is one of the earliest and largest masonry dams in the world.

questions.question: The 'Kalamkari' art form, known for hand-painted or block-printed textile designs, is native to which Indian state?
questions.explanation: Kalamkari (meaning 'pen work') is associated with Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. Srikalahasti and Machilipatnam are major centers.

questions.question: The Doctrine of Lapse, which allowed the British to annex any princely state where the ruler died without a natural heir, was aggressively implemented under which Governor-General?
questions.explanation: Lord Dalhousie (1848-1856) aggressively implemented the Doctrine of Lapse, annexing Satara, Jhansi, Nagpur, and other states. Lord Wellesley introduced the Subsidiary Alliance.

questions.question: In September 2025, ISRO launched the NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) mission. Which launch vehicle was used?
questions.explanation: NISAR was launched by PSLV (PSLV-C59) from Sriharikota in September 2025. It is a joint mission between NASA and ISRO.

questions.question: India won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup in June 2024 by defeating which team in the final?
questions.explanation: India defeated South Africa in the T20 World Cup final in Barbados in June 2024.

questions.question: At the 2024 Cannes Film Festival, which film won the Palme d'Or?
options: B) The Seed of the Sacred Fig
questions.explanation: 'Anora', directed by Sean Baker, won the Palme d'Or at the 2024 Cannes Film Festival.

questions.question: COP29 (29th UN Climate Change Conference) held in November 2024 was hosted by which city?
questions.explanation: COP29 was held in Baku, Azerbaijan in November 2024. Brazil will host COP30 in 2025.

questions.question: At the 2024 Cannes Film Festival, which actress won the Best Actress award for her performance in 'Emilia Pérez'?
questions.explanation: The Best Actress award at Cannes 2024 was given jointly to the four female leads of 'Emilia Pérez' - Karla Sofía Gascón, Selena Gomez, Zoë Saldaña, and Adriana Paz.

questions.question: Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai took oath as the 52nd Chief Justice of India in May 2025, succeeding which judge?
questions.explanation: Justice Gavai succeeded Justice Sanjiv Khanna as CJI in May 2025. Khanna had a brief tenure of about six months.

questions.question: Who won the men's singles title at the 2025 Australian Open, defeating Alexander Zverev in the final?
questions.explanation: Jannik Sinner won the 2025 Australian Open, defeating Alexander Zverev in the final. It was his third Grand Slam title.

questions.question: Scales : Justice :: Stethoscope : ?
questions.explanation: Scales are the symbol/tool of Justice, just as a stethoscope is the symbol/tool of a Doctor.

questions.question: Three of the following are alike in a certain way and one is different. Find the odd one out.
questions.explanation: Mercury is the smallest planet and closest to the Sun, with no natural satellite. Jupiter, Mars, and Venus all have natural satellites (or Mercury has no substantial atmosphere).

questions.question: A person walks 10 m East, turns left and walks 15 m, then turns right and walks 20 m. Which direction is the person facing?
questions.explanation: Starting facing East. Walk East → facing East. Turn left → facing North, walk 15 m. Turn right → facing East, walk 20 m. Final direction: East.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 11, 23, 47, 95, ?
A man says pointing to a woman: 'She is the only daughter of my father's only sister.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: Man's father's only sister = man's aunt. Only daughter of aunt = cousin to the man.

questions.question: In a code, each letter is shifted +2 (A→C, B→D, Y→A, Z→B). How is 'RAINBOW' coded?
questions.explanation: R→T, A→C, I→K, N→P, B→D, O→Q, W→Y. So RAINBOW = TCKPDQY.

questions.question: Find the missing letter in the series: Z, Y, W, T, P, K, ?
questions.explanation: The pattern decreases by successive integers: Z(-1)→Y, Y(-2)→W, W(-3)→T, T(-4)→P, P(-5)→K, K(-6)→F.

questions.question: In a code language, 'BEAUTIFUL' is written as 'UZFXSFTEGB' (each letter is replaced by the next letter in the alphabet, and then the word is reversed). Following the same rule, how is 'COMPUTER' written?
questions.explanation: First shift each letter +1: COMPUTER → DPNQVUFS. Then reverse: SFUVQNPD.

questions.question: The ratio of boys to girls in a school is 7 : 5. If there are 840 boys, how many girls are there?
questions.explanation: Ratio 7:5. Boys = 840. 7 parts = 840, 1 part = 120. Girls = 5 × 120 = 600.

questions.question: A student scored 45% marks and passed by 18 marks. If the passing percentage is 36%, find the maximum marks.
The average weight of 25 students is 48 kg. When the teacher's weight is included, the average becomes 49 kg. What is the teacher's weight?
questions.explanation: Total weight of 25 students = 25 × 48 = 1200 kg. With teacher: 26 × 49 = 1274 kg. Teacher's weight = 1274 - 1200 = 74 kg.

questions.question: A trader marks his goods 40% above cost price and gives a discount of 20%. What is his profit percentage?
Pipe A fills a tank in 6 hours, Pipe B in 8 hours. Pipe C empties it in 12 hours. If all three are opened together, in how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.explanation: Work per hour: A = 1/6, B = 1/8, C = -1/12. Combined = 1/6 + 1/8 - 1/12 = 5/24. Time = 24/5 = 4.8 hours = 4 hours 48 minutes.

questions.question: A sum becomes ₹3,600 in 2 years and ₹4,200 in 5 years at simple interest. What is the principal?
questions.explanation: Interest for 3 years = ₹600. Annual interest = ₹200. For 2 years = ₹400. Principal = 3600 - 400 = ₹3,200.

questions.question: The difference between CI and SI on a sum at 10% p.a. for 2 years is ₹63. Find the sum.
In a triangle, two angles are 45° and 75°. What is the third angle?
questions.explanation: Sum of angles = 180°. Third angle = 180 - 45 - 75 = 60°.

questions.question: In a class of 200 students, 55% are boys. How many girls are in the class?
If x + 1/x = 3, what is x² + 1/x²?
The table shows sales of a company (in ₹ lakhs): Year 2021: 240, 2022: 300, 2023: 360. What is the average annual sales over the three years?
A rectangular field has length 60 m and breadth 40 m. What is the cost of fencing it at ₹12 per metre?
If a² + b² = 25 and ab = 12, what is the value of (a + b)²?
A solid hemisphere of radius 6 cm is melted and recast into a cone of base radius 6 cm. What is the height of the cone?
questions.explanation: Volume of hemisphere = (2/3)π × 6³ = 144π. Volume of cone = (1/3)π × 6² × h = 12πh. Equating: 12πh = 144π. h = 12 cm.

questions.question: Statements: All cats are dogs. All dogs are birds. Conclusions: I. All cats are birds. II. All birds are cats.
questions.explanation: All cats are birds follows by transitivity. Conclusion II does not follow.

questions.question: If 15 August 2025 falls on a Friday, what day of the week is 15 August 2026?
questions.explanation: From 15 Aug 2025 to 15 Aug 2026 is 365 days. 365 mod 7 = 1. Friday + 1 day = Saturday.

questions.question: At what time between 2:00 and 3:00 will the hour and minute hands of a clock be at right angles?
questions.explanation: At 2:00, hour hand leads by 60°. For minute hand to be 90° ahead: 6m = 60 + 0.5m + 90 → 5.5m = 150 → m = 300/11 = 27 3/11 min. So time is 2:27 3/11 min.

questions.question: Six friends A, B, C, D, E, F sit in a row facing north. C sits in the middle. B sits immediately left of C. D sits at the extreme right end. A sits between D and E. Who sits at the extreme left end?
questions.explanation: Positions 1-6 from left. C at 3 (middle of 6). B immediately left of C → B at 2. D at extreme right → D at 6. A between D and E → E at 5, A at 4. Remaining: position 1 = F. So F sits at extreme left.

questions.question: Statements: Some apples are fruits. All fruits are healthy. Conclusions: I. Some apples are healthy. II. Some healthy are apples.
options: B) Both conclusions I and II follow
questions.explanation: Some apples are healthy follows by syllogism. 'Some apples are healthy' converts to 'Some healthy are apples' (conversion of I-proposition). Both follow.

questions.question: Four workshops - W, X, Y, Z - are scheduled on four consecutive days (Day 1-4), one per day. Conditions: (i) W is not on Day 1. (ii) X is on the day immediately after Y. (iii) Z is on Day 3. (iv) Y is not on Day 4. Which workshop is on Day 2?
questions.explanation: Z is on Day 3. X must be immediately after Y, so Y-X must be consecutive. Available pairs: Day1-Day2, Day2-Day3, Day3-Day4. Day 3 is Z, so Y-X can't be Day2-Day3 or Day3-Day4. Only Day1-Day2: Y on Day 1, X on Day 2. W can't be Day 1 (taken by Y), so W is on Day 4. X is on Day 2.

questions.question: Three persons - P, Q, R - each have a different profession (Engineer, Doctor, Lawyer) and each lives in a different city (Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai). Facts: (i) P is not the Doctor and does not live in Mumbai. (ii) The Engineer lives in Delhi. (iii) Q lives in Chennai and is not the Engineer. (iv) R is the Doctor. Who is the Lawyer?
questions.explanation: R is the Doctor. The Engineer lives in Delhi. Q lives in Chennai, so Q is not the Engineer. P is not in Mumbai, so P must be in Delhi. Therefore P is the Engineer. Q is the Lawyer.

questions.question: Which gas is used in the preparation of soda water (carbonated water)?
questions.explanation: Soda water is prepared by dissolving carbon dioxide under pressure.

questions.question: The largest organ in the human body is:
questions.explanation: The skin is the largest organ in the human body, covering about 1.5-2 square metres in an adult.

questions.question: A ball thrown vertically upward has zero velocity at the highest point. What is its acceleration at that point?
questions.explanation: At the highest point, velocity is zero but gravity continues to act. Acceleration = g = 9.8 m/s² downward.

questions.question: The 'Greenhouse Effect' in Earth's atmosphere is primarily caused by which gas?
questions.explanation: CO2 is the primary greenhouse gas responsible for the greenhouse effect. Other GHGs include methane and N2O.

questions.question: Which disease is transmitted by the bite of the Aedes mosquito?
questions.explanation: Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti. Malaria is transmitted by Anopheles mosquito. Cholera and Typhoid are waterborne.

questions.question: Which of the following is a chemical change?
questions.explanation: Burning of paper is a chemical change (combustion produces CO2 and H2O). Melting, boiling, and dissolving are physical changes.

questions.question: A block of wood floats in water with 40% of its volume submerged. What is the density of the wood relative to water?
questions.explanation: By Archimedes' principle, for a floating object, fraction submerged = density of object / density of water. So density of wood = 0.4 × density of water.
